business_name: Crown Pools of DeSoto - Pools & Supplies

data.name: Crown Pools of DeSoto - Pools & Supplies

reviews.text: We are extremely satisfied with Crown Pools. Mason the Sales Manager answered every question. Mr. Mendez the pool installer was amazing. On time or early, communication was excellent and he did a great job leveling part of our rock/forest for the installation. The electrician was great two. We are enjoying our pool. I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Randi Gheta

reviews.text: Always ready to answer questions in person or over the phone followed by the absolute best customer service hands down. Don’t bother shopping around to get a better price to maybe save a few dollars anywhere else. Mason and the rest of the crew at Crown Pools Desoto will definitely take the time to sell you exactly what you need at reasonable price.
reviews.author: Pamela Davidson

reviews.text: Fantastic customer service!  Mason walked us through everything we would need and answered all our questions.  Justin the installer was here to get started within about a week.  They did a BEAUTIFUL job replacing our above the ground pool.  We absolutely love it and we are so Happy we came to you guys for all of your professional help.  Definitely A++++++ 😊
reviews.author: Brandy Downes

reviews.text: We recently purchased a home with an above ground pool the previous owners had installed back in 2010 from Crown Pools. I had been going to another pool store for what I needed but decided to check this store out. I went yesterday and the guy who helped me was very kind. I noticed the prices are reasonable compared to the store I was going to before. We’re still learning how to clean and keep our pool clean. Our kids can’t wait to finally use the pool. 😁 I will be coming here now for all our needs!
reviews.author: Mayra Sanchez

reviews.text: My pool cleaner broke. I took it to Crown Pools since they were recommended by the manufacturer. Mason was very knowledgeable. He tested the cleaner and solved this issue quickly. He even helped locate my serial number so that I could get warranty coverage on the part that was needed. Good customer service and fast diagnosis!
reviews.author: Shay Frazier

reviews.text:
Crown Pool DeSoto, keep doing what you’re doing. Mason, the sales manager, is extremely professional and helpful. He most definitely is an asset to this location.

I recently had an issue with my pool cleaning robot and he was able to get me all squared away and running again without breaking the bank. In today’s world, it’s not every day that we find good, honest people, but Mason sure was.

He was very communicative, letting me know the status of my robot with updates throughout the process. He sent me a video of my functioning robot once it was ready to be picked up.

Thanks again! Cheers!
reviews.author: Denver Laughlin

reviews.text: We have been wanting to do this type of underground pool for years and we finally pulled the plug and we got our pool installed in late March. We are Beyond thrilled with not only the service from Mason at Crown Pools, but from his contractor that installed the pool. We cannot wait for this summer to enjoy our beautiful pool and make memories. We want to thank Mason for all his guidance. Between all the emails, his patience and kindness stayed solid. The overall experience was top notch. We highly recommend Crown Pools. Thx again. 😊
reviews.author: Sara Trevino

reviews.text: Made our dream pool come true with only half the cost of regular pools! My customer rep Marcos was professional and very knowledgeable,  he is still helping me when i have questions of how to take care of my pool properly.
reviews.author: Family in Faith tx

reviews.text: Excellent service. We love our pool, and everyone at Crown has been amazing in the whole process. Mason excels at customer service. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Russell Bartholomee

reviews.text:
The installers that Crown Pool use are are terrible.  Crown DeSoto has two installers, and both are awful.  They don't return calls/texts, they schedule work and then don't show up, and are generally just very unprofessional.
I ended up going to Bonnie and Clydes.  They use Cambell's Pool installation, and I had a much better experience with them.
reviews.author: Trail Swag

reviews.text: Mason and his Team at Crown Pools Desoto did a wonderful job helping us pick our pool, educated us on how things work, getting the install ready. Everything was a breeze and our still offering there services after the sell to get the pool water just right. We will be using Crown Pools for all our needs, Thanks Mason!!
reviews.author: Shawn Blanchet

reviews.text: Love these guys they keep my 1960s hot tub up and running just wish they would fill it up with ladies. They keep my pool fresh n ready to go. Bless and thank you.
reviews.author: Vancarlus Tennison

reviews.text:
Came here to have my pool water tested and purchase some needed supplies. Staff was very helpful. Will recommend this business to anyone of my friends and neighbors. Ill be coming back here for all my water testing and supplies from now on.
Thanks.
reviews.author: Orlando Llerena

reviews.text:
We recently had a pool installed by Crown Pools, and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish. Justin, who managed our project, was exceptional.

Justin was incredibly patient and kept us informed throughout the entire process. His knowledge and expertise were evident as he guided us through every step, offering valuable suggestions that enhanced the final design. He ensured we understood what was happening at each stage and promptly and professionally addressed our questions and concerns.

What stood out the most was Justin's dedication to ensuring our satisfaction. He consistently went above and beyond to ensure we were happy with the progress and the finish product. The final result exceeded our expectations, and we couldn't be happier with our beautiful new pool. ❤️

We highly recommend Crown Pools, for anyone considering an inground pool or any pool needs. Their professionalism, attention to detail, and commitment to customer satisfaction are top-notch.
reviews.author: Camilla Spencer

reviews.text: The staff is usually quite friendly every time that I go, and they provide good advice when it comes to water balancing issues. However, it is very frustrating when I need to get something. They consistently close before their posted closing time on the weekdays and are closed on Sundays. I work till 5 M-F, and it takes 45 min to get there from where I work. It would be nice if they stayed open until the time that they have listed. Not to mention, it would be nice if I didn't get an attitude when I do happen to make it before they close.
reviews.author: Byron B

reviews.text: My pool is gorgeous and the process was smooth thanks to Mason and Horacio.  The best customer service anyone could ask for!! Thank you Crown Pools Desoto!!
reviews.author: Aarti Soni

reviews.text: Crown Pools in DeSoto is amazing, especially the Sales Manager Mason. I had a Union Nut on my pump crack and my Doughboy Pools dealer in Waco, TX had just recently closed down. Mason took my issue and feverishly worked to find the parts I needed. Within a few days I had the parts in hand and was able to repair the pump. Mason took expert care of my needs and kept me informed throughout the entire process. Even though I live over an hour away and might not ever step foot in the store, Crown Pools and Mason made me feel like i was a local.
reviews.author: Jason Phelps

reviews.text: Dylan is a rock star at this place. Very knowledgeable, helpful and easy to work with.
reviews.author: Charles Mcduffie

reviews.text: I bought my pool in 2010 from crown pools in DeSoto.  I have been so happy with all services.  This year I had to replace my liner and have my filter sand changed out.  The young man who did that work was Justin.  He is so professional while working but more than that he explained things to me about what he was doing AND gave me tips on how to better care for my pool.  If you ever need a job done right, you can trust Justin to do that.  The rest of that team is also equally helpful as well!  And management is so on top of their game.  Thanks to all of you for making pool ownership a “breeze”!
reviews.author: Janis Whitt

reviews.text: It is worth the drive every time to go to Crown Pools! I pass many other pool supply establishments on my way to Crown but am never tempted to stop because the outstanding service we receive at Crown Pools in Desoto has earned my loyalty. Crown pools has excellent pricing, service and amazing customer support.  We buy our chemicals, get our water tested & have our equipment serviced by Crown and they have always gone out of their way to help take the stress out of pool maintenance. A special shoutout to Mason, a sales associate & tech who has resurrected our pool robot on multiple occassions with great communication, expediency & excellent worksmanship...all for a very fair price and without trying to upsell us into new equipment or uneeded repairs! 15/10 recommend Crown Pools as a trusted resource!
reviews.author: Alethea Schroen

reviews.text: I have been a customer there since the late 80's. For the last 10+ years,  Marcos Coronado has been my "go to" guy.  He is very knowledgeable about all aspects of the pools.  He is very professional and I trust his advice. We bought our new pool from him in 2020.  He has never hesitated to offer his assistance and answer all my questions.
reviews.author: Diane Sanchez

reviews.text: Very good swimming pool and spa store.  They have just about everything you would need to take care of your swimming pool or spa / hot tub. You can purchase chemicals, parts, pool equipment, pumps, and filters. The store attendants are friendly and knowledgeable about anything you need to know concerning your pools. They have a large stock, and 9 times out of 10 will have what you need. I highly recommend this store and will be returning often. After all, cleaning pools is my business. Knights Equinox pool and spa cleaning.
reviews.author: Michael Ballard

reviews.text: I Have a great experience every time I go into the store.  Marcos is always very knowledgeable and is always helpful in answering questions regarding pool service.   He has been out to my house on several occasions to clean my filter and has done a great job. He is a real asset.
reviews.author: DST Diva Travel and Vacation Dreams

reviews.text:
I am very satisfied with the great customer service I have received from Marco's, at crown pools,  each and every time I come in he goes above and beyond to make sure that I have every that I need  and answer all questions that I have.
Marco's is a great employee and is well informed about above ground pools.
And knows his products very well.
Over all great personality and awesome customer service .
reviews.author: Paul Castillo

reviews.text: Marcus was the most knowledgeable and helpful associate I have encountered in a long time if ever!!!! I will definitely be recommending people to him as well as the store!!! Totally awesome experience that made us smile. This guy needs a raise or promotion!!! Thanks for all you guys do for us as well!!
reviews.author: Raymond Price

reviews.text: Always very friendly and knowledgeable.   Never try to sell more product than is necessary  to keep our pool in excellent condition.  We have also had maintenance work done and their service  is prompt and thorough.   BTW we purchased our pool from them and highly recommend  them.
reviews.author: Sandra Jobst

reviews.text: We bought our pool here 8 years ago. It was great service then and continues to be. Their staff is polite, well trained, and helpful. We go in there with a problem and they help us work it out. We drive a bit to get there and it is worth it. We are still enjoying our pool.
reviews.author: Joy Trail

reviews.text:
The entire staff is knowledgeable,  but one in particular goes above and beyond..Quindell. I can't say enough about how well Quindell worked with me in detail. From the testing of the water to the replacement liner and parts , finally seeing it thru with an amazing installer. The original pool was bought at Crown 9 years ago as well.

With the customer service that was given by Quindell, it made the experience better than it had started out to be. His attention to detail and patience with the  decision making process speaks volumes in his true nature of being customer oriented. Ask for him by name, you will not be disappointed! ...or just ask for "Q"...
reviews.author: Linda T

reviews.text: The staff was wonderful! Dylan tested my water and gave helpful information for a new filter system . He directed me to Mark  whom was real helpful, he answered my call every time and walked me through every step and had great atitude.This was awesome customer service. I give them a 10 star rating. Mark you get 20 star, thanks for all your help.
reviews.author: james ward

reviews.text: I’ve only just discovered Crown Pools. Super helpful and knowledgeable staff. The store is well- stocked and organized. I’ll gladly drive the distance from Duncanville and make this my go-to place when I need supplies or help with my swimming pool.
reviews.author: Kristin

reviews.text:
Bought a $500+ pool cleaner that does not work. Product does not work, went to store for a refund for a refund or exchange and they refused. They advised "there is nothing we can do" [for broken products]. They won't even look at the machine to see if they can repair. Just threw $500 in the toliet

We will be calling your store again for remedy.
reviews.author: Garet Donohoo

reviews.text: Marcos Coronado has always been so helpful over the past 8 years with all of our pool needs. He is very knowledgeable about all aspects of pools from the chemicals to the construction from beginning to end. My husband and I have always appreciated his professionalism and look forward to many more years of his help.
reviews.author: Tricia Thompson

reviews.text: Fantastic pool store. Had a Maytronics robot pool cleaner that stopped functioning. These guys figured out the problem in 1 day and charged a very fair price. I will be bring my swimming pool need to them in the future.
reviews.author: Eric Goodman

reviews.text: I ran into some issues with my hoses not sealing properly on my above ground pool setup.  I went to Crown Pools and asked for the most knowledgeable person for pumps and filters.  Everyone pointed at Marcos, i told him my issues and he was extremely helpful and took the time to explain what i needed to do.  After doing what he said, i ran into a couple of other issues, went back up there and again he took the time to help me thru the issues.  Marcos is your man up there.  Thanks!
reviews.author: Faira Rhodes

reviews.text:
I just want to Thank the pool store owner for helping me with my pool problems. I use Pristine Blue and man this is the best pool chemical I have ever use in my 6 years of being a pool owner. My pool began to become brown at the bottom throughout the entire pool and I was terrified of having to change chemistry on pool or yet alone having to replace the entire pool liner. I went in to discuss my pool issues and the owner got the Pristine Blue book 📖 out and began reading on how to properly see how we can test to exactly see what was at the bottom of my pool. I went home and ran the test and OMG I’m so Thankful because it was only organic buildup from not enough shocking, I was told differently how to use Pristine by another store so therefore I wasn’t using the product correctly and it resulted in organic buildup at the bottom.

Thank you so much for educating me on the proper way to use Pristine Blue I will Be forever grateful of you and can continue to use this lovely product.

Keep being Great!!!
reviews.author: Shanetta Jones

reviews.text: When I go there, the staff always seems to have a forced politeness, almost sarcastic politeness to people of color.  They are  "politely" sarcastic, rude and condescending.   They are in it to make a buck, not friendly except towards whites.  I made a purchase with my credit card, and I had to return the purchase.  They refused the return, would not even offer an exchange, because I could not find my receipt, but the Credit Card machine clearly showed my purchase and the sales person confirmed he sold it to me.
reviews.author: R Johnson

reviews.text: We go here for all of our pool needs.  They are always super friendly and have helpful advice on what we need to do to keep our pool clean and running well.
reviews.author: Geneise Waltmon

reviews.text: Thank you so much Janette for hooking me up with your fantastic installation crew (Mendez Installations)! They have saved our horrible initial install from a local company and we were so pleased to see the enormous difference from a piss-poor installation job.....to what the Mendez Installation did! They brought the proper equipment, leveled the ground the right way, had a rolling water compactor to compact the ground, installed the proper blocks under the posts, used proper level reading equipment, and did a fantastic job! They even had a portable, inflatable water storage thing that was filling with water while they were doing all the ground work and pool install, so that after they installed the liner, they pumped the water that had been filling....over into the newly installed pool! Such professional work! It's so nice to see the same water line all around the pool in the same spot on the design of the liner for a change!!!!! Thank you so much for taking care of us! Paying the extra money for coming out long distance to Joshua, TX was soooooo worth it! I will recommend you guys to everyone I know!!!!
reviews.author: RebelWithoutApplause

reviews.text: I bought my above ground pool here back in 2020. It took a few months for delivery and installation because of the incredibly high demand, but the installation went well (buried halfway in ground) and the pool is working great.
reviews.author: reginafwddell

reviews.text: Just bought a pool here and the customer service was phenomenal. Marcos was the one helping me out. I will be definitely coming here over any other shop from now on for pool supplies!
reviews.author: John Price

reviews.text: Good place to go for parts/supplies for above ground/vinyl liner pools.  Staff has always been friendly and helpful.  My only complaint is that they don't offer a discount for pool professionals, which means our customers pay higher prices.
reviews.author: Thom Robinson

reviews.text: Great service and professional advice to keep your pool pristine and low maintenance for the summer. Bring your pool water sample to the bar to see if you need any adjustments. Grant suggested a new product for my pool last year and it worked.  Get a bucket or two of " The Surpreme" .
reviews.author: Victoria Chaverri

reviews.text: I went there and bought what I thought I needed 2 days later. Come to find out there was a more specific product out there. I'm sorry I went back and got a refund with absolutely no problems or questions.
reviews.author: Javier Chavarria

reviews.text: This business is crooked. I literally took my Polaris in for servicing and was told they were awaiting the part. Months later my spouse went in to pick the Polaris up because we never heard from the company and was advised that one of the technicians had the Polaris. Again after 2 weeks, I called and spoke with Justin who advised that the employee had the Polaris and when asked when I could pick the device up,Max advised that he threw my Polaris away. This is unacceptable and I will take legal action!
reviews.author: Mary Morris

reviews.text: Really great customer service, I just moved into a house here in Desoto and they were able to help me start up my swamp and winterize it for the off-season. They wrote down step by step and followed up with me. Thanks Justin for all your help!
reviews.author: Trenton Lee

reviews.text: Every time I go the employees are super nice and helpful. They answer all my questions and even told me I can bring my test strip in to find what I need for my pool. They made my Covid19 summer better

reviews.text: I drive 60 miles just to get my supplies here. Love everyone who works there. They are like family now.

reviews.text: Great place. Very friendly helpful staff. They seem to have everything you might need for your pool. Helped me find a special part for my above ground pool vacumn. Live in desoto, this needs to be your pool store. Noce home town place.

reviews.text: Great Customer Service! Thanks Dillion!

reviews.text: Got my pool from here last year. My family and I love it. Amazing customer service and even better products!

reviews.text: I can not be more happy with this company you guys are great business working with Marcos really gave me the information that I needed he was very knowledgeable about everything I needed to get my pool done right thanks for all the help
